New personal Play accounts (created after Nov 2023) must run a closed test with 12+ testers opted in continuously for 14 days before production access review (~7 days).

WWE Raw airs live on Netflix (2026).

learnings.text: Fastest video right now: 'SUBSCRIBE 💢 RANDY ORTON RKOs RANDY ORTON Onto a Chair' (UlterMonster Wrestling) at 61.9 views/hour — 163.0x the niche median.
Top-decile velocity videos share title terms: randy, orton, highlights, subscribe, rkos, simulation, aew, all. Test these patterns against the baseline before adopting.

Niche velocity baseline: median 0.4 views/hour across 78 recent videos (The DRAX, Titantron MHD, UlterMonster Wrestling, VokerTheBeast 2K, WrestleMania 2K, Wrestling With Simulations). Videos beating 3x median are outliers worth studying.

Macro Sep 2026: Fed priced 70% for an October hike with 10Y at 5.25%; Fed governor Cook says AI productivity gains will arrive too late to offset building inflation pressure. Geopolitics (Hormuz) is the market's main driver, not earnings.

AI-led autonomous science is producing real results: Anthropic's enzyme discovery and OpenAI's Navier-Stokes proof claim both came from agent fleets working with minimal human direction. The assistant-to-coworker shift extends into research.

The AI race has shifted from 'smartest model' to control of the full stack: chips, datacenters, electricity, enterprise software, security layers. Frontier economics now dominate strategy (AMD $8.2B physics-lab acquisition, Nvidia $150B buyback).

Underpricing signals low value, not bargain: successful 2026 indie apps charge $7.99-14.99/mo for focused tools. Subscription fatigue is real — apps must deliver ongoing new/personalized value to hold subscribers.

2026 subscription sweet spots: weekly $4.99-5.99 + 3-day trial is the LTV champion ($49.27 at 12 months); weekly plans are 55.6% of all app subscription revenue (2025), converting 1.7x-7.4x better than annual.
Falling behind Play's target API level doesn't remove your app — it makes it invisible to new users on newer devices. A slow, quiet failure, not a loud one. Stay ahead of the annual August ratchet.

Frontier model pricing dropping fast (late Sep 2026): Sonnet 5.5 ~30% cheaper/faster than Sonnet 5, GPT-6 Sol/Luna ~50% cheaper than 5.6, Opus 5.5 ~40% cheaper than Opus 5. AI operating costs are deflating — good for automation-heavy projects.
Frontier AI industry shift Sep 2026: from AI assistants to AI coworkers. New models (GPT-6, Opus 5.5) are designed for autonomous multi-step work and delegation, not just conversation.
YouTube Shorts now does 90B+ daily views (2026) with a mature pooled-revenue model: all Shorts ad revenue pooled, distributed by share of total views, creators get 45% of allocation.
On YouTube Shorts, using original audio instead of licensed music lifts RPM ~40%: music licensing fees are deducted from the shared revenue pool before creators get their 45% cut.
YouTube Shorts RPM 2026: US $0.04-0.08 per 1k views, UK/CA/AU $0.03-0.06, global $0.02-0.05. Roughly $40-80 per 1M US views. Shorts are volume game, not per-view game.
